attr.title: The Familia (Mafia)
attr.desc: Beta. Mafia: The City of Lost Heaven (2002, v1.2) statically recompiled to ARM64, with OpenGL ES rendering and the original videos. Your own copy of the game is required. About 25-30 FPS in the city on the H700; a full playthrough is not yet verified.
attr.inst: Copy The Familia.sh into your Ports folder and the_familia into ports. Put your own Mafia files in the_familia/source: the three CD images (.bin+.cue or .iso), mafia_patch_1.2_eng.exe and an unprotected 1.2 Game.exe (loose or in a .rar/.zip/.7z). Start The Familia: the first run imports them (about 2 GB, several minutes). See README.md.
